verdict.rationale: Docusaurus has built-in MDX support for writing JSX in Markdown and importing components defined in other files, which gives writers a mechanism to reuse content across pages. However, the evidence never describes Markdown snippets, partials or content variables specifically, so writers would likely need to build reuse out of React components. Missing for 10: documented Markdown partials/snippet includes, a variables or substitution mechanism for repeated values, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of content reuse workflows.
